title: Haaye Muslim ko Bachane Koi toh Aaye Bhala
body:
Khoon ke Aansu Rulane Aur Tadapne Lage
Zulm Jab Muslim pe Zaalim Ja Ba Jaa Dhane Lage
Di Sada Yeh Fatima ne Koi Toh Aaye Bhala
